LanguageData.HE_Roma.label: Nova Roma Republic
LanguageData.HE_Roma.description: Heirs of the colony ship Aeternitas, the citizens of Nova Roma rebuilt the republic of their ancestors on a new world: a senate, two consuls, roads that run straight across any land and legions that march in step. They are master builders and disciplined soldiers, proud of their law and slow to forgive.
LanguageData.HE_Roma.doctrine.label: testudo
LanguageData.HE_Roma.doctrine.description: Legionaries close ranks and lock their shields into a roof. Packed together they shrug off arrows and blows, but they march slowly.
